items.description: Bursa is a major city in northwestern Turkey, known for its Ottoman history and beautiful green parks. It served as the first capital of the Ottoman Empire.
Eskisehir is a vibrant city in central Turkey, famous for its lively student population and the Porsuk River flowing through the center. It has transformed into a modern cultural hub.

Pamukkale is a natural site in southwestern Turkey famous for its white travertine terraces formed by mineral-rich thermal waters. It is an iconic destination often paired with the ancient city of Hierapolis.
